_about: What the parser must read from each fetched sample resume (evals/resumes/external/<id>.*, listed in external_sources.json). Written by reading each file's dated lines. 'Present' in an old sample runs to today, so years have a floor, not an exact value. kind: single (one resume), packet (several resumes in one file; not checked until it is split), template (placeholder text, no real dates).

hr_manager_shrm_1.note: Every word gap is three spaces. The second employer line carries the dates of the whole stay (1999 - 2020) with five dated roles beneath it.

hr_manager_ucberkeleypeop_1.note: Employer line with the dates of the stay, three dated roles beneath it, then a second employer with its role title on the next line.

ldp_rutgersunivers_1.note: Title and dates on one line with no separator. 'Project Engineer 2004-2007' must not read as the Projects heading.

marketing_manager_rutgersunivers_1.note: Sub-bullets marked with the letter o.

marketing_manager_hofstraunivers_1.note: Four internships: they are roles, but they add no years of work. Month and year split by wide gaps (Jun   2015-Present).

business_analytics_northeastwisco_1.note: Headings 'RELTATED EXPERIENCE' (misspelt in the source) and 'WORK   EXPERIENCE'. Full month names.

supply_chain_universityofrh_1.note: Known miss: the PDF breaks a year in two ('Waiter 20 21 - present'), so that job is not read.

supply_chain_utdallasnaveen_1.note: A bullet says 'sales from 2004-present': not a job. Clubs under ORGANIZATIONS are dated but add no years of work.

management_consultant_universityofpe_1.note: Dates are written 'October 20 xx': no year to read.

brand_manager_vanderbiltuniv_1.note: Word template with no years in it.

ldp_universityofio_1.note: Word template with no years in it.

ldp_universityofma_1.note: Guidelines plus several sample resumes in one Word file.
